findings.title: JavaScript errors in the console
findings.description: 1 console error on 1 page, including 1 uncaught exception.
findings.recommendation: Open the browser console on each listed page and fix the errors; uncaught exceptions often mean a feature silently does not work.

findings.title: Buttons that throw errors
findings.description: 1 button threw a JavaScript error when clicked.
findings.recommendation: Fix the click handler; the error message is shown with each item.

findings.title: Touch targets too small
findings.description: 115 controls are smaller than 24x24px on mobile (WCAG 2.5.8 minimum).
findings.recommendation: Increase padding on small controls so the tappable area is at least 24px, ideally 44px.

findings.title: Form fields without labels
findings.description: 3 form fields have no label. Placeholder text disappears on input and is not announced reliably.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible <label for=...> to each field, or aria-label where a visible label truly does not fit.

findings.title: Decorative glows, blur blobs, and glass panels
findings.description: Found 105 colored glow shadows, 59 blurred background blobs, 27 glass panels. Layered glows and glass are decoration the content does not ask for, and they flatten hierarchy because everything shines equally.
findings.recommendation: Remove decorative blobs and glow shadows. Use elevation sparingly and with neutral shadows; keep at most one deliberate accent effect per page.

findings.title: Emoji used as icons
findings.description: 10 heading, button, or labels use emoji as decoration or icons. Emoji render differently on every platform, cannot be styled to the brand, and are a strong signal of generated UI.
findings.recommendation: Replace emoji with a consistent SVG icon set (one stroke width, one size scale) or drop the icon entirely where the label is clear.

findings.title: 37 different font sizes
findings.description: Text uses 37 distinct font sizes (9px, 9.5px, 10px, 10.5px, 11px, 11.5px, 12px, 12.5px, 13px, 13.5px, 14px, 14.5px, 15px, 15.5px, 16px, 16.5px, 17px, 17.5px, 18px, 20px, 22px, 24px, 26px, 28px, 30px, 34px, 36px, 38px, 40px, 44px, 48px, 52px, 56px, 64px, 68px, 70px, 72px). A type scale usually needs 6 to 8 steps; more than that blurs hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Define a type scale as tokens and map every text style to it. Collapse sizes within 1 to 2px of each other.

findings.title: Buttons that do nothing
findings.description: 2 buttons produced no visible change when clicked (no navigation, no DOM update). Hover-only or CSS-only effects can cause false positives, so confirm by hand.
findings.recommendation: Wire the button to its action, or remove it. If it is a placeholder for a future feature, hide it until the feature exists.

findings.title: Repeated paragraphs
findings.description: 1 paragraph appear more than once across the site. Repeated copy suggests sections were duplicated rather than written.
findings.recommendation: Write copy specific to each place it appears, or remove the duplicate.

findings.title: Text too small to read on mobile
findings.description: 130 text elements are smaller than 12px on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Keep body text at 16px and secondary text at 13 to 14px or larger on small screens.

findings.title: Heading structure problems
findings.description: 5 pages have heading structure problems. Headings are how assistive technology users skim a page.
findings.recommendation: Use exactly one h1 per page and do not skip levels; style headings with CSS instead of picking tags for their size.

findings.recommendation: Give each page a unique title and description, and set <html lang>.

findings.title: 17 different corner radii
findings.recommendation: Use two or three radius tokens (for example small controls, cards, and full pills) and apply them by component type.

findings.title: 65 different shadows
findings.description: There are 65 distinct box-shadow values. Elevation without a system makes depth meaningless.
findings.recommendation: Define two or three elevation levels and use them consistently.

findings.title: Different pages, same template
findings.description: Across 8 distinct page types, 68% of section structure is shared on average. Pages with different purposes are built from the same blocks in a similar order.
findings.recommendation: Design each page around its own task: an about page tells a story, a pricing page compares, a docs page navigates. Reuse components, not whole page skeletons.

findings.title: Spacing off a consistent scale
findings.description: 91% of padding, margin, and gap values are not multiples of 4px.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a spacing scale (4px or 8px based) and replace one-off values with tokens.
